name: Pixel 7a
notes: Carrier-locked units (e.g. some US carrier models) may never allow OEM unlocking; buy an unlocked one.

modes.fastboot: Power off. Hold Volume Down and press Power until "Fastboot Mode" shows with a red triangle, then plug in USB. Do not press Start.

unlock.text: OEM unlocking must be on; the installer then unlocks over USB (wipes the phone).
steps: Back up everything. Unlocking erases the phone.
Settings › About phone: tap Build number until Developer options turn on.
Settings › System › Developer options: OEM unlocking on (needs internet once).
The installer unlocks the bootloader; confirm on the phone with the volume keys and Power.
hints: Update the stock OS first so the firmware is current.
Use a direct USB-C port, no hub, and a good cable.

recovery.text: Back to stock: Google's flasher at flash.android.com. Before it, with the bootloader unlocked, run `fastboot erase avb_custom_key` so the GrapheneOS key is no longer trusted.
